headline: Arsenal's aura of champions evaporates after Brighton thrash them 3-0
description: The strengths that won Arsenal the title deserted them at Brighton, which celebrated their 125th anniversary with a thumping victory over the champions.

headline: Arsenal 'in trouble from first throw-in' at Brighton - Mikel Arteta
description: Mikel Arteta said he knew Arsenal would be "in trouble" from "the first throw-in" in a 3-0 defeat at Brighton.

headline: European soccer live updates: Brighton humble Premier League champs Arsenal
description: Another weekend of European soccer action continues with Brighton & Hove Albion hosting Premier League leaders and defending champions Arsenal.

headline: Newcastle end Hull's unbeaten record with early brace
description: Hull's unbeaten start to life in the Premier League came to an end with a 2-1 defeat to Newcastle at St James' Park.
